subject: german
title: Polite Phrases
meta_desc: KS3 German: please, thanks, sorry, you're welcome.
final_note: Polite words go a long way in Germany.

walkthroughs.body_html: Bitte means both please AND you're welcome. Context tells you which. If you say 'Danke' to a German they often reply 'Bitte'.
Danke = thanks. Danke schon = thanks a lot. Vielen Dank = many thanks (more formal).
Entschuldigung works as 'excuse me' or 'sorry'. Es tut mir leid is a deeper 'I'm really sorry' — for bigger apologies.
